title: Postmortem & action plan: tokenization-config drift caused eval quality drop
creator: Maya Patel
description: Summary: A runtime change to the default tokenizer normalization parameters (unicode normalization and unknown-token handling) was rolled out as part of a build that included unrelated performance fixes. That rollout produced a measurable regression on several evaluation suites (NER, code completion prompt benchmarks, and a subset of customer-facing conversational evals) where token boundaries materially affect model outputs. Impact surfaced through alerting on eval drift; customer-facing latencies were unchanged but per-response quality on targeted UAT sets dropped ~6-9% (F1/ROUGE-like metrics) for affected prompts.
comments: 2026-02-21 - Maya Patel: Triage notes - alert triggered by eval-drift pipeline. Initial investigation shows tokenizer mismatch between model training config and runtime. Filed ENG-25901 to capture postmortem and remediation plan.

2026-02-23 - Leo Zhang: Reproduced locally with model v2026-01-12. Observed tokenization differences for names and punctuation-heavy prompts. Hypothesis: a change in normalization and unk-token splitting in tokenization library introduced during runtime dependency bump.

2026-02-26 - Priya Rao (Applied ML): Run: compared model-training tokenizer config to runtime -- found two fields different: normalizer='NFKC' vs 'NFC' and handle_unknown='split' vs 'map_to_unk'. These explain boundary shifts and downstream decoding differences.

2026-03-01 - Engineering lead review: Approved emergency revert for canary cluster while we draft automated guards. Revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1182. Canary rollbacks completed 2026-03-02.
2026-03-04 - Design/PM feedback (Ava Chen): Need to add tokenization-sensitivity examples to the alert dashboard and ensure runbook steps are explicit for rollback/communication.

2026-03-10 - Leo Zhang: Implemented tokenization equivalence check harness and golden snapshots. Test PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/450. Added new eval tests to CI; currently running in staging.
2026-03-12 - Maya Patel: Updated ticket with final action list and owners. Planning follow-up retro with infra, runtime, and applied-ml on 2026-03-18.
tasks: Root cause: confirm tokenizer config drift introduced in runtime dependency bump (done)
Immediate: rollback canary and schedule full rollback window if canary indicated broad exposure (done)
Short-term (1 sprint): add tokenization-equivalence unit to pre-deploy CI - compares runtime tokenizer output to model-trained tokenizer for sampled corpora (owner: Leo Zhang)
Short-term: create and store golden tokenization snapshots per-model (owner: Priya Rao)
Short-term: add targeted eval cases that are sensitive to subtoken boundaries (names, punctuation-heavy, code tokens) and include in nightly smoke evals (owner: Maya Patel)
Medium-term (2 sprints): extend rollout gating to fail if tokenization-equivalence deviation > threshold for any pinned model (owner: Runtime CI team)
Medium-term: add dashboard panels and alerting rules for tokenization-induced metric variance and example diffs (owner: Observability team)
Long-term: integrate tokenizer metadata into model catalog so deployments automatically select compatible tokenization config (owner: Model Onboarding)
Postmortem write-up and customer communication draft for affected pilot customers (owner: Customer Success)
Add retro items and update deployment runbooks with explicit tokenizer-check steps (owner: Eng Ops)
Create a small synthetic eval set specifically designed to detect tokenizer-sensitive regressions for future smoke runs (owner: Evals team)
Backfill missing regression tests that would have caught this: add tests for normalization variants, unk-handling, and special-token behavior (owner: QA)
Validate KV-cache/embeddings compatibility after tokenizer changes; ensure cache keys are tokenization-aware (owner: Serving Runtime)
Document lessons learned and link to artifacts (confluence + PRs) in closure notes (owner: Maya Patel)
Follow-up: schedule cross-team retro 2026-03-18 (owner: Maya Patel)
acceptance_criteria: CI includes tokenization-equivalence check that runs on all runtime builds touching tokenizer deps
Nightly smoke evals include tokenizer-sensitive cases and fail on regression beyond threshold
Golden tokenization snapshots created for active model versions and stored in eval artifacts bucket
Runbook updated with explicit rollback and communication steps for tokenization regressions
Dashboard panels added showing tokenization-delta examples and related metric changes
